title: From the label review notebook
passage:
Field observation | Packing-room label trial

Our old label shows the product code only in large type. The new label shows that code in the same place, with a smaller packing instruction below. Operators in this trial must identify a product and say how it should be packed. Reading the code correctly is not enough for a full pass.

There were two stations. Both stations had holders with adjustable label positions. The holder at Station 1 had a high lower rail. The holder at Station 2 had no lower rail. Staff could slide a label up before testing, but they could not remove the label or tip the holder during an attempt. If they changed the setup, the old attempt had to be logged separately.

Nora read the code at Station 1 but could not read the instruction because the rail hid the bottom of the label. A technician slid the label up and repeated the test, using the same holder. Nora then read both parts correctly. At Station 2 the instruction was already visible before anyone moved the label. The committee needs a separate recommendation for each station; it is not deciding whether the label should replace the old one everywhere.
passageZh:
現場觀察｜包裝室標籤試驗

舊標籤只以大字印產品代碼。新標籤也在同一位置印代碼，但下方另有字體較小的包裝指示。試驗要求操作員辨認產品，並說明應如何包裝。只讀對代碼不算完全通過。

共有兩個測試站。兩站的標籤架都可調整標籤位置。第一站的標籤架下方有一條高擋條；第二站的架子下方沒有擋條。試驗人員可以在測試前將標籤往上滑，但不能在測試進行中抽掉標籤或傾斜標籤架。若調整了配置，先前那次測試必須另外記錄。

諾拉在第一站讀得出代碼，但擋條遮住標籤下半部，她讀不到指示。一位技術人員把標籤往上滑，使用同一個標籤架再測一次。這次諾拉兩個部分都讀對了。第二站還沒有人移動標籤前，就已能看到指示。委員會需要針對兩站各提一項建議；這次不是要決定是否在所有地方用新標籤取代舊標籤。
